title: Fix MCP Tool Descriptions
description: All MCP tool descriptions in both the repo CLI (Go) and compose engine (Python) are not properly formulated. They contain garbage like emoji-prefixed tracking links in docstrings and vague/generic parameter descriptions. Clean up all tool, prompt, and parameter descriptions to be clear, concise, and professional.
summary: Cleaned up all MCP tool, prompt, and parameter descriptions in both repo CLI (Go) and compose engine (Python). Removed emoji-prefixed tracking links from all Python docstrings. Replaced vague descriptions with clear, concise text.
